# Seams — cross-phase logic errors and unclean dependencies

Found while planning Phases 6–16 ahead of implementation. This is the
**rework backlog**: each seam names the upstream layer that must change,
the test that will go red first, and the phase that can't go green until
it lands. A seam is closed only by an upstream fix + test, never by a
downstream workaround. Statuses: OPEN / FIXED(pr-link) / WONTFIX(justify
here, decision goes to spec/decisions.md).

| # | Seam | Where it bites | Owner | Found in | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Rules

1. A seam found while planning a later phase gets an entry **in the same
   sitting** as the phase plan that surfaced it.
2. Closing a seam = upstream fix + red-first test merged; the phase that
   depends on it lists the seam in its Prerequisites hard gate.
3. WONTFIX requires a decision entry in `spec/decisions.md`, not just a
   shrug here.
